mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `game_bakery_idle_score` (`family_id`, `user_id`, `score`) VALUES (#{familyId}, #{userId}, #{score}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `score` = VALUES(`score`)
mapper.select: SELECT s.`user_id` AS `userId`, s.`score` AS `score`, s.`updated_at` AS `updatedAt`, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`nickname`, ''), u.`username`) AS `name`, u.`avatar` AS `avatar` FROM `game_bakery_idle_score` s JOIN `sys_user` u ON u.`id` = s.`user_id` AND u.`deleted` = 0 JOIN `sys_user_role` ur ON ur.`user_id` = s.`user_id` AND ur.`family_id` = s.`family_id` WHERE s.`family_id` = #{familyId} ORDER BY s.`score` DESC, s.`updated_at` ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.`user_id` AS `userId`, s.`score` AS `score`, s.`updated_at` AS `updatedAt`, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`nickname`, ''), u.`username`) AS `name`, u.`avatar` AS `avatar` FROM `game_bakery_idle_score` s JOIN `sys_user` u ON u.`id` = s.`user_id` AND u.`deleted` = 0 JOIN `sys_user_role` ur ON ur.`user_id` = s.`user_id` AND ur.`family_id` = s.`family_id` WHERE s.`family_id` = #{familyId} AND s.`user_id` = #{userId}
